verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶל־ וַיִּקְרָ֥א בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיָּמִֽים׃ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- way·yiq·rā bā·nāw way·yō·mer hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū wə·’ag·gî·ḏāh lā·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiq·rā ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yā·mîm bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ
verses.literal: Then Jacob . . . called for his sons and said Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־ אֲבִיכֶֽם׃ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל
verses.transliteration: hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū wə·šim·‘ū bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·šim·‘ū ’el- ’ă·ḇî·ḵem yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Come together and listen O sons of Jacob listen to your father Israel

verses.original: רְאוּבֵן֙ אַ֔תָּה בְּכֹ֣רִי כֹּחִ֖י וְרֵאשִׁ֣ית אוֹנִ֑י יֶ֥תֶר שְׂאֵ֖ת וְיֶ֥תֶר עָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū·ḇên ’at·tāh bə·ḵō·rî kō·ḥî wə·rê·šîṯ ’ō·w·nî ye·ṯer śə·’êṯ wə·ye·ṯer ‘āz
verses.literal: Reuben you are my firstborn my might and the beginning of my strength excelling in honor excelling in power

verses.original: פַּ֤חַז כַּמַּ֙יִם֙ אַל־ תּוֹתַ֔ר כִּ֥י עָלִ֖יתָ אָבִ֑יךָ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י עָלָֽה׃פ יְצוּעִ֥י אָ֥ז חִלַּ֖לְתָּ
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaz kam·ma·yim ’al- tō·w·ṯar kî ‘ā·lî·ṯā ’ā·ḇî·ḵā miš·kə·ḇê ‘ā·lāh yə·ṣū·‘î ’āz ḥil·lal·tā
verses.literal: Uncontrolled as the waters you will no longer excel because you went up to your father’s bed onto my couch and defiled it

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וֹן וְלֵוִ֖י אַחִ֑ים מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ כְּלֵ֥י חָמָ֖ס
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî ’a·ḥîm mə·ḵê·rō·ṯê·hem kə·lê ḥā·mās
verses.literal: Simeon and Levi are brothers their swords are weapons of violence

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֔י אַל־ תָּבֹ֣א בְּסֹדָם֙ כְּבֹדִ֑י אַל־ תֵּחַ֣ד בִּקְהָלָ֖ם כִּ֤י הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ בְאַפָּם֙ עִקְּרוּ־ שֽׁוֹר׃ וּבִרְצֹנָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî ’al- tā·ḇō bə·sō·ḏām kə·ḇō·ḏî ’al- tê·ḥaḏ biq·hā·lām kî hā·rə·ḡū ’îš ḇə·’ap·pām ‘iq·qə·rū- šō·wr ū·ḇir·ṣō·nām
verses.literal: May I never enter their council may I never join their assembly For they kill men in their anger and hamstring oxen on a whim

verses.original: אָר֤וּר אַפָּם֙ כִּ֣י עָ֔ז וְעֶבְרָתָ֖ם כִּ֣י קָשָׁ֑תָה אֲחַלְּקֵ֣ם בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַאֲפִיצֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’ap·pām kî ‘āz wə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯām kî qā·šā·ṯāh ’ă·ḥal·lə·qêm bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wa·’ă·p̄î·ṣêm bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cursed [be] their anger for it is strong and their wrath for it is cruel I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ אַחֶ֔יךָ יוֹד֣וּךָ יָדְךָ֖ בְּעֹ֣רֶף אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ אָבִֽיךָ׃ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh ’at·tāh ’a·ḥe·ḵā yō·w·ḏū·ḵā yā·ḏə·ḵā bə·‘ō·rep̄ ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bə·nê yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Judah . . . your brothers shall praise you Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies your father’s sons shall bow down to you

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֔ה גּ֤וּר אַרְיֵה֙ בְּנִ֣י עָלִ֑יתָ מִטֶּ֖רֶף כְּאַרְיֵ֛ה כָּרַ֨ע רָבַ֧ץ וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֥י יְקִימֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh gūr ’ar·yêh bə·nî ‘ā·lî·ṯā miṭ·ṭe·rep̄ kə·’ar·yêh kā·ra‘ rā·ḇaṣ ū·ḵə·lā·ḇî mî yə·qî·men·nū
verses.literal: Judah is a young lion my son you return from the prey Like a lion he crouches [and] lies down like a lioness who dares to rouse him

verses.original: שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ לֹֽא־ יָס֥וּר מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמְחֹקֵ֖ק מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑יו עַ֚ד כִּֽי־ שִׁילֹה יָבֹ֣א יִקְּהַ֥ת עַמִּֽים׃ וְל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: šê·ḇeṭ lō- yā·sūr mî·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·ḥō·qêq mib·bên raḡ·lāw ‘aḏ kî- šī·lōh yā·ḇō yiq·qə·haṯ ‘am·mîm wə·lōw
verses.literal: The scepter will not depart from Judah nor the staff from between his feet until . . . Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his

verses.original: אֹסְרִ֤י עִירֹה לַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בְּנִ֣י אֲתֹנ֑וֹ וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָ֖ה כִּבֵּ֤ס לְבֻשׁ֔וֹ בַּיַּ֙יִן֙ סוּתֹה׃ וּבְדַם־ עֲנָבִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ’ō·sə·rî ʿī·rōh lag·ge·p̄en bə·nî ’ă·ṯō·nōw wə·laś·śō·rê·qāh kib·bês lə·ḇu·šōw bay·ya·yin sū·ṯōh ū·ḇə·ḏam- ‘ă·nā·ḇîm
verses.literal: He ties his donkey to the vine his colt . . . to the choicest branch He washes his garments in wine his robes in the blood of grapes

verses.original: עֵינַ֖יִם חַכְלִילִ֥י מִיָּ֑יִן שִׁנַּ֖יִם וּלְבֶן־ מֵחָלָֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·na·yim ḥaḵ·lî·lî mî·yā·yin šin·na·yim ū·lə·ḇen- mê·ḥā·lāḇ
verses.literal: His eyes are darker than wine and his teeth are whiter than milk

verses.original: זְבוּלֻ֕ן יִשְׁכֹּ֑ן וְהוּא֙ לְח֥וֹף יַמִּ֖ים לְח֣וֹף אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְיַרְכָת֖וֹ עַל־ צִידֹֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: zə·ḇū·lun yiš·kōn wə·hū lə·ḥō·wp̄ yam·mîm lə·ḥō·wp̄ ’o·nî·yō·wṯ wə·yar·ḵā·ṯōw ‘al- ṣî·ḏōn
verses.literal: Zebulun shall dwell . . . by the seashore . . . and become a harbor for ships his border shall extend to Sidon

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר גָּ֑רֶם חֲמֹ֣ר רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·š·ḵār gā·rem ḥă·mōr rō·ḇêṣ bên ham·miš·pə·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: Issachar [is] a strong donkey lying down between the sheepfolds

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא כִּ֣י מְנֻחָה֙ ט֔וֹב וְאֶת־ כִּ֣י הָאָ֖רֶץ נָעֵ֑מָה וַיֵּ֤ט שִׁכְמוֹ֙ לִסְבֹּ֔ל וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־ עֹבֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yar kî mə·nu·ḥāh ṭō·wḇ wə·’eṯ- kî hā·’ā·reṣ nā·‘ê·māh way·yêṭ šiḵ·mōw lis·bōl way·hî lə·mas- ‘ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: He saw that his resting place was good - and that his land was pleasant so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant

verses.original: דָּ֖ן יָדִ֣ין עַמּ֑וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: dān yā·ḏîn ‘am·mōw kə·’a·ḥaḏ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel

verses.original: דָן֙ יְהִי־ נָחָ֣שׁ עֲלֵי־ דֶ֔רֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹ֖ן עֲלֵי־ אֹ֑רַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ֙ ס֔וּס עִקְּבֵי־ רֹכְב֖וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏān yə·hî- nā·ḥāš ‘ă·lê- ḏe·reḵ šə·p̄î·p̄ōn ‘ă·lê- ’ō·raḥ han·nō·šêḵ sūs ‘iq·qə·ḇê- rō·ḵə·ḇōw way·yip·pōl ’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: He will be a snake by the road a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward

verses.original: קִוִּ֥יתִי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qiw·wî·ṯî lî·šū·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: I await Your salvation O LORD

verses.original: גָּ֖ד יְגוּדֶ֑נּוּ גְּד֣וּד וְה֖וּא יָגֻ֥ד עָקֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: gāḏ yə·ḡū·ḏen·nū gə·ḏūḏ wə·hū yā·ḡuḏ ‘ā·qêḇ
verses.literal: Gad will be attacked by raiders but he will attack their heels

verses.original: מֵאָשֵׁ֖ר לַחְמ֑וֹ שְׁמֵנָ֣ה וְה֥וּא יִתֵּ֖ן מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס מַֽעֲדַנֵּי־
verses.transliteration: mê·’ā·šêr laḥ·mōw šə·mê·nāh wə·hū yit·tên me·leḵ ma·‘ă·ḏan·nê-
verses.literal: Asher’s food will be rich he shall provide royal delicacies

verses.original: נַפְתָּלִ֖י אַיָּלָ֣ה שְׁלֻחָ֑ה הַנֹּתֵ֖ן שָֽׁפֶר׃ס אִמְרֵי־
verses.transliteration: nap̄·tā·lî ’ay·yā·lāh šə·lu·ḥāh han·nō·ṯên šā·p̄er ’im·rê-
verses.literal: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֔ף פֹּרָת֙ בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָ֖ת בֵּ֥ן עֲלֵי־ עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי־ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ pō·rāṯ bên pō·rāṯ bên ‘ă·lê- ‘ā·yin bā·nō·wṯ ṣā·‘ă·ḏāh ‘ă·lê- šūr
verses.literal: Joseph is a fruitful vine a fruitful vine by a spring whose branches scale . . . the wall

verses.original: בַּעֲלֵ֥י חִצִּֽים׃ וַֽיְמָרֲרֻ֖הוּ וָרֹ֑בּוּ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֻ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·lê ḥiṣ·ṣîm way·mā·ră·ru·hū wā·rōb·bū way·yiś·ṭə·mu·hū
verses.literal: The archers . . . attacked him with bitterness they aimed at him in hostility

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ זְרֹעֵ֣י יָדָ֑יו וַיָּפֹ֖זּוּ מִידֵי֙ אֲבִ֣יר יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִשָּׁ֥ם רֹעֶ֖ה אֶ֥בֶן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·šeḇ bə·’ê·ṯān qaš·tōw zə·rō·‘ê yā·ḏāw way·yā·p̄ōz·zū mî·ḏê ’ă·ḇîr ya·‘ă·qōḇ miš·šām rō·‘eh ’e·ḇen yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet he steadied . . . his bow and his strong arms . . . were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob in the name of the Shepherd the Rock of Israel

verses.original: מֵאֵ֨ל אָבִ֜יךָ וְיַעְזְרֶ֗ךָּ וְאֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִיבָ֣רְכֶ֔ךָּ בִּרְכֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מֵעָ֔ל בִּרְכֹ֥ת תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֣צֶת תָּ֑חַת בִּרְכֹ֥ת שָׁדַ֖יִם וָרָֽחַם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êl ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·ya‘·zə·re·kā wə·’êṯ šad·day wî·ḇā·rə·ḵe·kā bir·ḵōṯ šā·ma·yim mê·‘āl bir·ḵōṯ tə·hō·wm rō·ḇe·ṣeṯ tā·ḥaṯ bir·ḵōṯ šā·ḏa·yim wā·rā·ḥam
verses.literal: by the God of your father who helps you - and by the Almighty who blesses you with blessings of the heavens above with blessings of the depths vvv below with blessings of the breasts and womb

verses.original: בִּרְכֹ֣ת אָבִ֗יךָ גָּֽבְרוּ֙ עַל־ בִּרְכֹ֣ת הוֹרַ֔י עַֽד־ תַּאֲוַ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם גִּבְעֹ֣ת תִּֽהְיֶ֙ין֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: bir·ḵōṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā gā·ḇə·rū ‘al- bir·ḵōṯ hō·w·ray ‘aḏ- ta·’ă·waṯ ‘ō·w·lām giḇ·‘ōṯ tih·yɛn lə·rōš yō·w·sêp̄ ū·lə·qā·ḏə·qōḏ nə·zîr ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: The blessings of your father have surpassed . . . the blessings of the ancient mountains . . . and the bounty of the everlasting hills May they rest on the head of Joseph on the brow of the prince of his brothers

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִין֙ זְאֵ֣ב יִטְרָ֔ף בַּבֹּ֖קֶר יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְלָעֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bin·yā·mîn zə·’êḇ yiṭ·rāp̄ bab·bō·qer yō·ḵal ‘aḏ wə·lā·‘e·reḇ yə·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl
verses.literal: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf . . . in the morning he devours the prey in the evening he divides the plunder

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר כָּל־ וְ֠זֹאת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲבִיהֶם֙ דִּבֶּ֨ר לָהֶ֤ם וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אוֹתָ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֹתָֽם׃ כְּבִרְכָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl šə·nêm ‘ā·śār kāl- wə·zōṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḇî·hem dib·ber lā·hem way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·w·ṯām ’îš bê·raḵ ’ă·šer ’ō·ṯām kə·ḇir·ḵā·ṯōw
verses.literal: These are the tribes of Israel twelve . . . in all and this was what their father said to them He blessed them - - and he blessed each one - with a suitable blessing

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו אוֹתָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲנִי֙ נֶאֱסָ֣ף אֲלֵהֶם֙ עַמִּ֔י קִבְר֥וּ אֹתִ֖י אֶל־ אֲבֹתָ֑י אֶל־ אֶל־ הַ֨מְּעָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׂדֵ֖ה עֶפְר֥וֹן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’ō·w·ṯām way·yō·mer ’ă·nî ne·’ĕ·sāp̄ ’ă·lê·hem ‘am·mî qiḇ·rū ’ō·ṯî ’el- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāy ’el- ’el- ham·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer biś·ḏêh ‘ep̄·rō·wn ha·ḥit·tî
verses.literal: Then [Jacob] instructed them - - I am about to be gathered to my people Bury me with my fathers . . . in the cave - in the field of Ephron the Hittite

verses.original: בַּמְּעָרָ֞ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַמְרֵ֖א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־ קָנָ֨ה מֵאֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י קָֽבֶר׃ לַאֲחֻזַּת־
verses.transliteration: bam·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer biś·ḏêh ham·maḵ·pê·lāh ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê- mam·rê bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ’ă·šer haś·śā·ḏeh ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- qā·nāh mê·’êṯ ‘ep̄·rōn ha·ḥit·tî qā·ḇer la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ-
verses.literal: The cave is in the field of Machpelah - near . . . Mamre in the land of Canaan This is the field Abraham - purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site

verses.original: אֶת־ שָׁ֣מָּה אַבְרָהָ֗ם וְאֵת֙ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ שָׂרָ֣ה קָֽבְר֞וּ שָׁ֚מָּה יִצְחָ֔ק וְאֵ֖ת אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ רִבְקָ֣ה קָבְר֣וּ אֶת־ וְשָׁ֥מָּה קָבַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־ לֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- šām·māh ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·’êṯ ’iš·tōw śā·rāh qā·ḇə·rū šām·māh yiṣ·ḥāq wə·’êṯ ’iš·tōw riḇ·qāh qā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- wə·šām·māh qā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- lê·’āh
verses.literal: - There Abraham - and his wife Sarah are buried there Isaac - and his wife Rebekah are buried - and there I buried - Leah

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ מֵאֵ֥ת מִקְנֵ֧ה בְּנֵי־ חֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ham·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer- bōw mê·’êṯ miq·nêh bə·nê- ḥêṯ
verses.literal: The field and the cave that is in it . . . were purchased from the Hittites . . .

verses.original: יַעֲקֹב֙ וַיְכַ֤ל לְצַוֺּ֣ת אֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף רַגְלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַמִּטָּ֑ה וַיִּגְוַ֖ע וַיֵּאָ֥סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·ḵal lə·ṣaw·wōṯ ’eṯ- bā·nāw way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ raḡ·lāw ’el- ham·miṭ·ṭāh way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: When Jacob had finished instructing - his sons he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last and he was gathered to his people
